title: Remove wallpapers from 'dark stussy grunge' onward and set 'Cheetah B and W' as default

requirements.summary: Remove 'dark stussy grunge' wallpaper and all wallpapers that appear after it in the list
acceptanceCriteria: The wallpaper 'dark stussy grunge' no longer appears in the PersonalizationPanel grid.
All wallpapers that were listed after 'dark stussy grunge' no longer appear in the PersonalizationPanel grid.
Wallpapers listed before 'dark stussy grunge' remain unchanged.

file_operations.description: In the validTextures array, locate the entry for 'dark stussy grunge' and remove it along with every wallpaper entry that follows it in the array. Preserve all wallpaper entries that appear before 'dark stussy grunge' in the original order.

In the wallpapers array constant, locate the entry with label 'dark stussy grunge' and remove it along with every wallpaper object that follows it in the array. Keep all wallpaper objects that appear before 'dark stussy grunge' unchanged.

requirements.summary: Set 'Cheetah B and W' as the default background wallpaper for new visitors
acceptanceCriteria: When localStorage contains no saved background preference, the app renders with the 'Cheetah B and W' wallpaper active.
The 'Cheetah B and W' option is highlighted/selected by default in the PersonalizationPanel when no prior selection exists.

file_operations.description: Change the default background value in the useState initialization from its current value to 'cheetah-bw' (or the exact texture key used for 'Cheetah B and W' in the validTextures array). This ensures that when no localStorage preference exists, the hook returns 'Cheetah B and W' as the active background.
